no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not presented at Advisory Committee. The reasons for not taking this New Molecular Entity to Advisory Committee follow:

summary: No advisory committee meeting was held for Qutenza (NDA022395). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review and Summary Review both explicitly state the NDA was not presented at an advisory committee, citing that capsaicin is widely consumed and used in OTC monograph products, there is essentially no systemic absorption from the patch, efficacy was clearly demonstrated, and no clinically concerning safety signals requiring risk mitigation were identified. Because no committee convened, there were no committee concerns or AdCom-driven changes to the approval.
